note_en: To say "just like before," Chinese wraps the comparison in a frame: 像 + model + 一样, as in 像以前一样互相照顾 "look after each other just as before." The whole 像…一样 phrase comes before the verb, where English puts "like before" after it. Leaving out 一样 sounds incomplete in this pattern.
